instruction: A spiny armadillo lizard curled nose-to-tail into a ring, assembled from folded cardstock polygons with visible glue tabs along every seam. Overlapping cut-paper scale plates in sand, ochre and burnt sienna step outward in rows, each spike a sharply creased paper cone. Faint fold lines and slight paper warping catch raking light across the flat facets.
